title: RIGA completes cement mill upgrade project for Dangote Cement Senegal
summary: RIGA completes cement mill upgrade project for Dangote Cement Senegal
body_markdown: **Senegal:** RIGA has announced the completion of a Loesche cement mill upgrade at one of Dangote Cement’s plants in Senegal. The project involved a comprehensive mechanical and hydraulic upgrade, including complete replacement of three S-Rollers, replacement of three master roller tyres; mill liners; dam ring and central plate, manufacture and installation of a complete hydraulic system for the S-Rollers and an installation of new hydraulic lines and piping. RIGA said that the project required detailed planning, heavy mechanical works, precision installation, hydraulic system integration and close coordination with the plant team to ensure safe and efficient execution.
